title: DARPA DICE opens BAA solicitation HR001126S0010, closes 2026-08-25
summary: DARPA's DICE program (Decentralized Artificial Intelligence through Controlled Emergence) has an active Broad Agency Announcement, HR001126S0010, published 2026-06-10 on sam.gov with a proposal deadline of 2026-08-25. A Proposers Day was held with presentation materials posted; program manager is Susmit Jha. No program-level file currently exists for DICE beyond the org record.

title: Wikimedia Community Fund (Rapid/General Support/Hub Funds) missing from registry
summary: Wikimedia's grantmaking runs through the Wikimedia Community Fund, documented on Meta-Wiki: a Rapid Fund (avg. $500-$5,000, ~2 month turnaround), a General Support Fund (flexible multi-year operating support, up to 3 years, ~3 month turnaround), and a Hub Fund (multiple rounds/year). A July 2026-June 2027 General Support Fund round timeline was published 2026-06-09; a matching Rapid Fund cycle timeline was published 2026-04-15. No program file exists for this in the registry despite Wikimedia Foundation having a funder org record.

programs/wikimedia-community-fund.yaml.summary: Umbrella grantmaking program for the Wikimedia movement, comprising the Rapid Fund (avg. $500-$5,000, short-term projects), the General Support Fund (flexible multi-year operating support up to 3 years), and the Hub Fund (multiple rounds per year), open to individuals and organizations advancing knowledge equity.

title: Mantle EcoFund ($200M ecosystem capital pool) missing from registry/programs
summary: Mantle's own site describes the EcoFund, a $200M catalyzed capital pool backing early-stage projects seeking a long-term partnership with Mantle, run alongside 20+ venture partners (e.g. Polychain, Dragonfly) with 40+ portfolio companies across DeFi, gaming, infrastructure, and Bitcoin restaking. It is deal-based (fundraising/deal-structuring support, exchange-listing recommendations) rather than a fixed-round grants program; no award size, cadence, or formal application URL is published — interested teams are told to contact ecofund@mantle.xyz.

title: Lacuna Fund's own site says it is no longer being updated; leadership transferred away
summary: Lacuna Fund's homepage now leads with: "Lacuna Fund Transitions to Partners in Africa and Latin America" and states directly: "Please note that this site is no longer being updated. The content reflects the state of Lacuna Fund's work in July 2025. This site will be available until a new online presence and data repository are established." Site navigation now shows only "Past RFPs" (no current/open RFPs). The registry currently lists status: active; this is the org's own confirmation that its original entity is not actively grantmaking and its site is frozen — status should move to winding-down (or the successor partner institutions tracked separately) pending the owner's call on how to represent the transition.

title: GoodDollar profile names 'GoodBuilders' and 'Prosperity Grants' but current site shows only a generic grant form
summary: The registry profile names two specific programs, GoodBuilders and Prosperity Grants. GoodDollar's current homepage and /build page (the latter now 404) show no reference to either name — only a generic "Apply for a Grant" call-to-action linking to a Typeform (gooddollar.typeform.com/to/z7xUuBe3) reviewed by "a member of the grant committee." This could mean the named programs were folded into one generic intake, renamed, or simply moved off the pages checked; flagging as a possible profile drift rather than asserting the named programs are gone.
